Reviewer-directed fix. trim/collapse/upper, then strip trailing periods and spaces with regex_extract '^(.*?)[.\s]*$' so 'Australia.' structurally reduces to 'AUSTRALIA' before lookup (general rule, not one hardcoded dotted key). map_enum(passthrough=true) maps 'AUSTRALIA'/'AU'/'AUS' -> 'AU' and passes any unlisted letter-only name (ARUBA, SINGAPORE) through unchanged as uppercase text, so genuine foreign countries are neither dropped nor guessed. A final regex_extract '^(\D*)$' returns the value only when it contains no digits, so state+postcode mistypes such as 'WA 6105' become null instead of being emitted as a country; letter-only names are unaffected. 'default: null' is deliberately NOT used, since it would also null real foreign countries.
